_comment: Example only. The dashboard reads ./dashboard.config.json beside itself, and this
directory is VENDORED into every member under .claudinite/shared/ — where nothing
may be hand-edited, because the converge replaces the tree. So the real config is
never committed here: the site that DEPLOYS the dashboard writes it next to its own
copy. Absent config is a valid deployment, not a broken one — it means the
token-paste fallback and whatever repo the URL names.
`mode` is required and has no default: "repo" for this repo's own page,
"fleet" for the overview. Every other key below is optional. `canonRepo` is what the fleet view compares each
member's mount against; unset means member freshness reads unknown rather than
being guessed. A "fleet" mode names where its members come from — `owner`,
`repos` or `rosterUrl`. `digestsRepo` is where the fleet's morning briefs are
written — unset simply turns that panel off.
